subject.why: The harp is clearly recognisable, complete with its golden frame, strings, and the requested swan-neck tip.

category.why: The surface has realistic, photographic-looking marble veining instead of being painted in a smooth, stylized manner.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermark, or characters present.

framing.why: The harp is centered with ample margins on all sides.

colour.why: The palette is bright and warm with good contrast between the gold harp, pink gradient wall, and light surface.

detail.why: The harp itself is free of noisy micro-details, scratches, or unnecessary clutter.

style.why: The harp features smooth, chunky 3D volumes and a satin sheen matching the casual game style.

fix: Replace the photorealistic marble tabletop with a smooth, stylized surface such as polished wood or a plain glossy floor.
